notes: Rule 45's second clause applies here: the apodosis וַיֹּאמֶר opens with its own waw, so that waw carries the frame's that and הָיָה keeps only it came to pass. The accepted alignment had given that to הָיָה and left the waw unrepresented.
The briefing's alternative rendering would make Jerusalem the subject of came; the main rendering's pronoun reading is retained.
